name: flash-sale
//: Array form, deliberately: it is executed directly rather than through a shell, so there is no `&&` or `sudo` to be parsed differently by each editor. Zed fails on the string form. The image already ships a pnpm matching the packageManager pin, so corepack enable — which would need root here — is not required; if that pin moves far enough to diverge from the image, add corepack back via a Dockerfile stage rather than a lifecycle script.

customizations.//: Zed reads this same file and has its own `zed` key here, but extensions declared under it also install into the local Zed instance, so project settings live in .zed/settings.json instead where they stay scoped to the project.
